title: Exa MCP Server
summary: Add Exa's hosted MCP server so your agent can run neural web search and fetch full page contents with web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa.
description: Exa is a search engine built for AI use, and its hosted MCP server exposes two tools by default: web_search_exa for finding pages and web_fetch_exa for pulling a page's text. Optional tools such as web_search_advanced_exa can be switched on with a tools parameter on the URL.
This setup sends your Exa API key in the x-api-key header. Exa also supports OAuth, which you can use instead by leaving the header out and signing in through the client.
useWhen: Look up current library docs and release notes while coding
Find real-world examples of an API call you are unsure about
Read the full text of a page the agent found by search
Research a vendor or a standard before choosing it

example.result: Found the official migration page. Main changes: removed app.del, path-to-regexp stricter syntax, req.query is a getter, promise rejections reach the error handler.

faq.question: Where do I get a key?
faq.answer: Create one in your Exa dashboard and export it as EXA_API_KEY before starting the agent.

faq.question: Can I skip the key?
faq.answer: Exa lists OAuth as its preferred route. Remove the header and use your client's sign-in flow for the same URL.

faq.question: How do I enable more tools?
faq.answer: Add a tools parameter to the URL listing every tool you want, for example web_search_exa and web_search_advanced_exa. The list replaces the defaults.
